status: candidate - pre-freeze review revision; freeze policy applies after split review approval

upstream_files: apps/v4/registry/themes.ts (theme neutral - theme-neutral.css generated by scripts/theme.js)

scope: rust-ui is desktop-only + fully desktop-responsive; mobile is out of scope (responsive != mobile). The 1440x1000 DPR1 viewport is the deterministic CAPTURE viewport, not a fixed-size layout contract. Upstream mobile paths (Sidebar Sheet/offcanvas/useIsMobile) stay in vendored files untouched and are never transcribed.

tiers.core: required for the first native rust-ui Gallery/component milestone - complete visually material desktop state/size coverage
tiers.later: planned desktop component, not in the first native milestone - representative coverage
tiers.reference-only: retained visual coverage, no native promise

install_transforms.note: emulated upstream install-time transformers for this config (packages/registry/src/utils/transformers)
install_transforms.menu: transform-menu.ts - menuColor=default removes cn-menu-target AND cn-menu-translucent (they are placeholders; only *-translucent inline the translucent classes, inverted* swaps cn-menu-target->'dark')
install_transforms.rtl: transform-rtl.ts - rtl=false -> skipped (no direction/logical-side transform, cn-rtl-flip markers absent)
install_transforms.font: transform-font.ts - cn-font-heading retained; --font-heading: var(--font-sans) in gallery.css -> resolves to Geist
install_transforms.icons: transform-icons.ts - iconLibrary=lucide -> no-op (source paths already lucide)
install_transforms.cleanup: transform-cleanup.ts - strips transient cn-* markers only (cn-rtl-flip, cn-logical-sides); recipe cn-* classes retained

font.canonical: Geist / Geist Mono - upstream Nova canonical fonts, vendored OFL woff2
font.proof: EXHAUSTIVE fail-closed: CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode on every element with a non-whitespace direct text node + every input/textarea value/placeholder; empty/error/non-Geist/non-custom result fails capture. marked=1209 proven=1209 resolved sans=[Geist] mono=[Geist Mono]

capture_platform.deterministic: fixed viewport/dpr/zoom; animations+transitions disabled; caret hidden; no timestamps/randomness/network

devctl_bridge: automation ids == future rust-ui .automation_id(...) == UIA AutomationId; future rust-ui-devctl rect/hover/click/focus/type/snapshot-layout/compare consume contract.json
